heading: Failure modes
text:
### Failure modes [RARC.9.6]

| Failure | When detected | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Undeclared dialect in rule file | Compile | Hard compile error with dialect list |
| Unknown form for this dialect | Compile | Hard compile error per [LDIA.3.4.2] |
| Call to an undeclared service | Compile | Hard compile error. The service set is fixed at compile time and carried in the `.dsc` ([RARC.9.4.2]), so this is always statically knowable |
| Call to a declared service with no registered callback | Runtime | Fails at dispatch. There is no startup check, because nothing is published at startup to check against ([RARC.9.4.2]) |
| Adapter cannot reach what it fronts | Runtime | The callback returns `CallError` with a code it chooses ([RARC.9.5.2]); the engine has no concept of a disconnected adapter ([RARC.14.5]) and live streams continue |
